biggest_catch: Reimbursement is paid in loyalty points redeemable only for Rhythm bill credits — not cash — and is applied only after your 91st day of active service, requires on-time bill payment, and is a one-time-only offer.
catches: Reimbursement comes as loyalty points equal to the fee, redeemable only for Rhythm bill credits — no cash value.
Paid only after your 91st day of active service with Rhythm; you must pay bills on time and have no past-due charges.
One-time-only eligibility; Solar Buyback and Variable plans are not eligible.
You must email Rhythm within 60 days of starting service with (a) your old supplier's bill showing the ETF charge and (b) the payment receipt.
Max reimbursement is $150 — if your old provider's fee is higher, you eat the difference.
Switching to Rhythm means a new 12+ month contract with Rhythm's own rate and a $10–$20/month-remaining early termination fee after the 30-day test drive.

steps: Sign up for an eligible Rhythm plan (non-Solar-Buyback, non-Variable) and switch from your current supplier.
Within 60 days of starting Rhythm service, email Rhythm: (1) a copy of your old supplier's bill showing the early termination fee charge, and (2) the receipt for your payment of that fee.
After your 91st day of active service (with bills paid on time and no past-due charges), Rhythm applies loyalty points equal to the ETF value (up to $150) redeemable for bill credits.
